_note: Derived. Never hand-edited: BanzAI states profile identifiers, names, purposes and inheritance from the normative registry so a change there cannot leave a stale answer behind. Localized prose may wrap these facts; the facts themselves are not translated and not re-authored.

profiles.name: Protocol Sandbox
profiles.purpose: Prove the protocol can be instantiated in a controlled test environment and that the core monetary representation is correct.

profiles.name: Core Payment Capability
profiles.purpose: Consumer payment, merchant acceptance, transfer and traceability capability.

profiles.name: Payment Initiation Capability
profiles.purpose: Payment request, payment initiation and instant execution capability.

profiles.name: Inter-Operator Interoperability
profiles.purpose: Cross-operator routing, inter-operator settlement and automated reconciliation. This is the federation eligibility threshold.

profiles.name: External Interoperability
profiles.purpose: Integration with external payment networks and acquiring infrastructure.
